method: Quoted notice lines only: remove Markdown quote prefixes, collapse whitespace, split attribution prefix from first Permission sentence. Read each unique terms variant and every attribution prefix. Original source bytes remain authoritative; normalization is comparison evidence, not replacement license text.

findings: 71 quoted MIT/ISC sections, five exact normalized term variants.
Three MIT variants differ in quote punctuation; ISC and Lodash variant retained separately.
Lodash adds CC0 documentation sample language and separate node_modules/vendor license caveat; preserve original full notice.
Other license blocks and metadata-only gaps are covered by separate prior reviews; no new source/binary equivalence or legal clearance is asserted.
